recipe.title: •BoShek
recipe.caption: •BoShek (V)
recipe.game_text: {pilot:3}. Deploys -2 to Cantina, a docking bay, or a starship. BoShek is a matching pilot for any starship. Twice per game, may ▲ a device. Immune to attrition < 3.
recipe.lore: Rogue pilot. Outlaw starship tech. Has secret lab in Mos Eisley. He bragged about beating Han Solo’s Kessel Run record. Left fringe life behind after meeting Obi-Wan Kenobi.

recipe.title: Fusion Generator Supply Tanks
recipe.caption: Fusion Generator Supply Tanks (V)
recipe.game_text: Deploy on a docking bay or your capital starship. Your unique (•) starships are power, maneuver, and hyperspeed +1. May place this device in Lost Pile to cancel Lateral Damage. If opponent controls this location, place this device in Used Pile.
recipe.lore: Uses standard fusion technology. Provides starships with energy for hyperspace travel. Installed at docking bays and throughout the Outer Rim Territories.

recipe.title: •Gold 1
recipe.caption: •Gold 1 (V)
recipe.game_text: May add 2 pilots or passengers. If Dutch piloting, power +2, immune to attrition < 4, and once during any control phase, may take the top or bottom card of your Force Pile into hand.
recipe.lore: Lead fighter of Gold Squadron at Battle of Yavin. Flown by Jon ‘Dutch’ Vander. Designated Specter 1 at Renforra Base.

recipe.title: •Han’s Heavy Blaster Pistol
recipe.caption: •Han’s Heavy Blaster Pistol (V)
recipe.game_text: Deploy on Han (except TK-422), even as a ‘react.’ May target a character or creature for free. Draw destiny. Target hit, its forfeit = 0, and opponent loses 1 Force if destiny +1 > defense value. Once during your control phase, may fire using 1 Force.
recipe.lore: BlasTech DL-44 heavy blaster pistol. Short range, but relatively powerful. Carries energy for 25 shots. Illegal or restricted in most systems.

recipe.title: •Luke Skywalker
recipe.caption: •Luke Skywalker (V)
recipe.game_text: {pilot:3}. If piloting lead starfighter, Attack Run total is +3. During your control phase, if piloting at a battleground, may ▲ one Darklighter Spin or retrieve 1 Force.
recipe.lore: Son of Anakin Skywalker. Student of Obi-Wan Kenobi. Honed piloting skills while bullseyeing womp rats in Beggar’s Canyon aboard T-16 skyhopper.
recipe.copyright: TM & © 1995 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1995 DECIPHER INC.

recipe.title: Sai’torr Kal Fas
recipe.caption: Sai’torr Kal Fas (V)
recipe.game_text: Deploy on table. During your deploy phase, if you just deployed a unique (•) character, may ▼ a matching weapon on that character. {alter}
recipe.lore: Saurin female from planet Durkteel. Bodyguard of Hrchek, a Saurin droid trader. Sai’torr will teach battle skills to those who prove themselves worthy.
recipe.copyright: TM & © 1995 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1995 DECIPHER INC.

recipe.title: Assault Rifle
recipe.caption: Assault Rifle (V)
recipe.game_text: Deploy on Chief Bast or your Imperial warrior. May target a character, creature, or vehicle at same or adjacent site using 1 Force. Draw destiny. Target lost if destiny +1 > defense value.
recipe.lore: BlasTech model DLT-19 “heavy blaster rifle.” Enhanced with extra power packs and greater range.

recipe.title: •Black 2
recipe.caption: •Black 2 (V)
recipe.game_text: May add 1 pilot. During your deploy phase, may ▲ one Pride Of The Empire. All Wings Report In and Organized Attack are canceled. While DS-61-2 piloting, immune to attrition < 5.
recipe.lore: TIE/ln assigned to pilot DS-61-2. Has 27 ‘flames’ on cockpit, one for each Rebel kill. Control yoke has a holo of Mithel’s young son, Rejlii.

recipe.title: Blaster Rack
recipe.caption: Blaster Rack (V)
recipe.game_text: Deploy on table. During your deploy phase, if you just deployed a unique (•) character, may ▼ a matching weapon on that character. {alter}
recipe.lore: Imperial facilities, like the Death Star and garrison bases, have blaster racks at key locations to equip soldiers with weapons like blaster rifles and thermal detonators.

recipe.title: •Darth Vader
recipe.caption: •Darth Vader (V)
recipe.game_text: {pilot:4}. While aboard a starship, it is immune to attrition < 5. During battle at same system (twice if with a Black Squadron pilot), may cumulatively subtract 3 from a just drawn destiny. Immune to attrition < 5.
recipe.lore: Dark Lord of the Sith. Servant of Emperor. Encased in armor with cybernetic life support. Student of Obi-Wan Kenobi. Was the best starpilot in the galaxy. Cunning warrior.
recipe.copyright: TM & © 1995 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1995 DECIPHER INC.

recipe.title: Fusion Generator Supply Tanks
recipe.caption: Fusion Generator Supply Tanks (V)
recipe.game_text: Deploy on a docking bay or your capital starship. Star Destroyers and unique (•) TIEs are immune to attrition < 3. May place this device in Lost Pile to cancel Hyper Escape or Power Pivot. If opponent controls this location, place this device in Used Pile.
recipe.lore: Installed at many facilities throughout the Empire to provide power to the Imperial spacefleet. Supplies starships with energy necessary for sub-light and hyperspace travel.

recipe.title: •Prophetess
recipe.caption: •Prophetess (V)
recipe.game_text: Deploy -1 and forfeit +3 at a site. Once per turn, may peek at top card of opponent’s Reserve Deck or Used Pile; may then shuffle that Reserve Deck or Used Pile. Immune to attrition < 3.
recipe.lore: Renowned female psychic. Predictor of doom. Agent for Governor Aryon of Tatooine. Tailed Jabba and his thugs to Docking Bay 94 when they confronted Han Solo.
